subject: [Invite] ICCV AI Data Leaders Dinner - 21st Oct
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our CEO, [SENDER] is hosting an intimate roundtable dinner for AI & Data Leaders at ICCV and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private room at Empire Steakhouse (~10 min walk from the conference) on Tuesday 21st October from 7pm. Confirmed attendees include CxOs and senior technical leaders from Nexar, Woven by Toyota, and Philips.

It'll be an informal, open-format evening - no slides or pitches, just bringing together like-minded people to discuss their experiences & challenges working with AI data.

Would you be interested in joining / available on the 21st?

subject: ICCV - ML pipelines that scale for Board Member
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will anyone from StrataVision be at ICCV this year? Thought there's a good
chance you might be, and I'd love to grab a coffee to hear how things are
progressing since you last spoke to Encord.

Aware you are using CVAT for annotations, but we usually find that's around
the stage you're at is when teams start reaching out to Encord to help
scale their ML pipelines, as many find that CVAT is great to start, but
struggles with robustness as they scale (e.g. breaking videos into frames
for annotation rather than handling them natively).

Let me know if you'll be at ICCV? Happy to grab a quick coffee and trade
notes on the space or feel free to swing by our booth (#605) and we show
you our new features that might make it worth evaluating us again.

Either way, would be good to keep the relationship going.

subject: [SENDER] - deepfake detection
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw your deepfake-shield offering so I wanted to reach out. We work on
projects with Onfido, Reality Defender and Veriff for deepfake detection
model development - thought it's worth a quick chat.

In case Encord is new to you... we're a multimodal data development
platform supporting over 200 AI teams to improve training data quality at
scale. We're designed for cutting dataset rep time, boosting throughput,
and iterating faster.

Would love to explore if there's synergy to collaborate! I'm flexible
Tue-Thu mornings PT if you're open to exploring.

subject: pick & place
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the demo of your pick & place robotic arm, thought I'd reach out since
we recently helped Pickle Robot increase grasping accuracy by 15% while
boosting iteration cycles 6x times faster.

Before Encord they were training on simulation data and lacked a system to
effectively index, auto-label and QA to keep up with the surging volume.
Curious if you're facing similar challenges on data collection and
perception model training?

In case Encord is new to you...we help warehouse robotics teams (Osaro,
Mytra, Fox Robotics, etc) automate annotation pipelines as they scale. They
leverage out model-assisted workflow and out labelling editor's support
across 2D and 3D/sensor data, as a complement to debugging/visualisation
tools.

Keen to explore if there's synergy to team up - let me know if you are open
for a quick chat.

subject: Coffee at ICCV'25?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw there's a Computer Vision in Advertising workshop at ICCV this year.
Some AI teams I work on projects with (Zefr & IAS) are taking part. Seems
quite aligned with the ContextIQ paper you co-authored - are you planning
to attend?

A bit of context - I work with CTV teams on improving multimodal training
data quality. We unify auto-annotation with human review across video,
audio and text classification, to make ground-truth labeling more accurate
and human validation more efficient.

Would you be open to exchanger perspectives over a coffee? I'll be at ICCV
Tues (10/21) to Thurs (10/23), or happy to connect virtually if you prefer.

subject: ICCV - ML pipelines that scale for Deep Learning Engineers
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will anyone from [COMPANY] be at ICCV this year? Thought there's a good chance
you might be, and I'd love to grab a coffee if so.

Would be great to talk about [COMPANY]'s plans going forward as we find that's
usually around the stage you're at is when teams start reaching out to
Encord to help scale their ML pipelines. Many AI teams find that early,
in-house systems work well to start, but struggle with robustness as they
grow (e.g. breaking videos into frames for annotation rather than handling
them natively).

Would be great to hear where [COMPANY] is at and share how we've helped teams
like Flock Safety, LVT, and Milestone Systems unify their data curation,
annotation, and model evaluation through our video-native platform for
father model deployment, whilst saving them time and money across their ML
pipelines.

Let me know if you'll be at ICCV? Happy to grab a quick coffee and trade
notes on the space or feel free to swing by our booth (#605).

subject: [Invite] SF Autumn AI Leaders Dinner, 10/30 @ Spruce
text:
Hi [NAME],

My co-founder, [SENDER], is hosting a dinner in SF for AI leaders later this
month (Thurs 10/30) for ~20 Founders, CTOs and Heads of AI working on
interesting and multimodal AI use cases. Aware Safely You uses Voxel 51,
but we're big fans and been following you for a while, so would love to
personally invite you.

We've booked a private room at Spruce, starting at 6.30pm with good food
and drink, and plenty of time to network (no slides, no set agenda). We
have confirmation from execs at Verkada, Voxel AI and Flock Safely in the
CV and awareness detection space.

At our AI summer dinner in Palo Alto, guests included execs from NASA,
Verkada, Acubed by Airbus and Thinking Machine Labs, with the conversation
covering AI challenges in unmanned air taxis to multimodal foundation
models for physical AI

Let me know if you're interested and I'll save you a spot - more than happy
to share full details.

Hope to see you there!

subject: partner with [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed the AI estimate feature on your website - I assume you're building
vision models to interpret photos or floorplans.

We recently helped Zoopla on similar projects for floor plan generation and
property inspection. A lot of teams run into scaling issues once data
outgrows in-house or open-source annotation tools. Encord helps cut
training data prep time and boost throughput (~5x faster) while improving
data quality.

Quick context: Encord is also YC-backed (W21), $50M Series B, and supports
200+ AI teams across vision and multimodal AI.

Would you be open to a quick chat and explore if there's a fit to
collaborate? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays.
